title: Dogs Were Banned, So Lord Byron Got a Bear
script: When the poet Lord Byron was a student at Cambridge, the rules said no dogs allowed. So he got a bear. Byron kept a tame bear at Trinity College, and since bears weren't mentioned in the rules, there wasn't much the college could do. He even joked in a letter that the bear should sit for a fellowship. Students have been finding loopholes for centuries, but this one is hard to top.
scenes: Young Lord Byron in regency clothing smiling
Tame bear walking beside him on a leash
Shocked college officials in black robes
Bear sitting at a desk in a cap and gown
